title: Independence of section comparison from a Cartesian ambient lift
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring killed by an integer $N>0$. Let $Y,Y'$ be Noetherian schemes with $N$ invertible on $Y$. Let $f:X\to Y$ and $f':X'\to Y'$ be smooth, separated, compactifiable, of the same pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-asd-compactifiable], with closed sections $s,s'$ [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Work in the ordinary etale derived categories and put $C=s^*f^\times A$ and $C'=s'^*f'^\times A$ using the compact-support right adjoints of [lem-pur-noetherian-etale-section-specialization]. Fix $b:Y'\to Y$. Suppose $v,w:X'\to X$ each give a Cartesian square $(v,f',f,b)$ and $(w,f',f,b)$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and $vs'=sb=ws'$. Then their actual counit-defined section comparisons $b^*C\to C'$ of [lem-pur-noetherian-etale-section-specialization] are equal.

source.place: Proof (1), orientation comparison; composition of counit-defined comparisons

proof.text: The two universal pullback isomorphisms give a=X'≅X' such that a≫v=w and a≫f'=f'. Cartesian uniqueness and the section commutativities imply s'≫a=s'.
Apply composition coherence to v followed by a. The comparison for w is the pullback comparison for v followed by the comparison for a, with the inverse-image compositor.

Invertibility of N pulls back to Y'. Replace the comparison for a by the identity-inverse-image comparison. Its naturality moves it past the comparison for v, and the left identity law for inverse-image composition cancels the compositor.

theorem sectionMap_eq_of_cartesian
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian Y']
    (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y')
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f']
    [IsSeparated f] [QuasiCompact f] [HasCompactification f]
    [IsSeparated f'] [QuasiCompact f'] [HasCompactification f']
    (s : Y ⟶ X) (s' : Y' ⟶ X') [IsClosedImmersion s] [IsClosedImmersion s']
    (hs : s ≫ f = 𝟙 Y) (hs' : s' ≫ f' = 𝟙 Y')
    (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (b : Y' ⟶ Y) (v w : X' ⟶ X)
    (sqv : IsPullback v f' f b) (sqw : IsPullback w f' f b)
    (hv : s' ≫ v = b ≫ s) (hw : s' ≫ w = b ≫ s) :
    sectionMap A f f' b v sqv s s' hv = sectionMap A f f' b w sqw s s' hw
